identity.mission: Create a 'Notion-style' task manager that feels like a digital sanctuary. Clean, intellectual, and hyper-functional.
principles: Content is King: The UI recedes, the user's thoughts take center stage.
Tactile Minimalism: Use subtle borders and textures instead of heavy shadows.
Intellectual Typography: Mix Serif headings with Sans body for a 'document' feel.
Calm Palette: Use desaturated pastels for organization, never neon.

typography.instructions: Import 'Newsreader' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts. Use Newsreader for all H1-H3 headings to give it that 'Notion' editorial vibe. Use Inter for all UI text, inputs, and buttons.

cards.style: bg-white border border-border rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
cards.kanban_card: p-3 bg-white border border-border/60 rounded-md shadow-sm hover:border-border/100 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing

inputs.style: h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

sidebar.style: border-r border-border bg-sidebar h-screen sticky top-0 hidden md:block

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Keep them thin (stroke-width={1.5}) for elegance.

images.description: Subtle white/gray concrete texture for login page or empty states.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Configure Tailwind to use the custom colors defined in 'colors.palette'.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that includes the Sidebar (desktop) and Mobile Nav.
4. Use the 'Newsreader' font for all Page Titles (H1) and Section Headers (H2).
5. Implement the Kanban board using 'dnd-kit' or similar if complex, or simple HTML5 drag-and-drop if basic requirements.
6. Ensure the 'Task Modal' uses a clean, distraction-free layout (like a sheet or centered dialog).
7. Use the 'tags' color palette for Task Priorities and Categories.
8. IMPORTANT: Default to Light Mode. Dark mode should be a toggle.
9. For the Dashboard, use a Bento Grid layout to show 'Tasks Due Soon', 'Priority Breakdown', and 'Recent Activity'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
